title: Saint Nicholas comes to Antwerp.
lines: It's November, and it's cold outside.
The leaves have fallen from the trees.
But in Antwerp all the children are very happy.
Because Saint Nicholas is coming!
Saint Nicholas lives in Spain, far away in the south, where it's warm.
He is a kind old man with a long white beard, a red cloak and a tall red mitre on his head.
And he has a golden staff.
Every year he comes to our country on a big steamboat.
And this year the boat arrives in Antwerp, on the river Scheldt!
Anaya is standing by the water with Daddy and Mummy.
She's wearing a hat and a warm scarf.
There are lots and lots of children.
They wave little flags and sing songs.
And then they hear it: Toooot!
Here comes the steamboat!
Smoke comes out of the chimney.
Saint Nicholas is standing on the deck.
He waves to everyone.
And everywhere on the boat there are Petes, his helpers.
They wear colourful clothes, and a hat with a feather.
They climb the ropes, they make jokes and they do cartwheels.
Hooray!
Hello, Saint Nicholas!
shouts Anaya as loud as she can.
The boat docks.
Saint Nicholas climbs onto his big white horse.
The horse is called Ozosnel.
He can walk over the roofs, even when it's dark.
The Petes throw sweets.
Pepernoten, little round biscuits that taste of cinnamon.
Anaya catches a few in her hat.
Mmm!
In the evening Anaya puts her shoe by the fireplace.
She puts a carrot in it for the horse, and a drawing for Saint Nicholas.
She has drawn a steamboat, with Saint Nicholas and Anaya on it.
And she sings a song before she goes to sleep.
That night Saint Nicholas rides his horse over the roofs.
Clip, clip, clip, go the hooves.
A Pete climbs down the chimney.
He takes the carrot and the drawing.
And he puts something in the shoe.
The next morning Anaya runs straight to the fireplace.
The carrot is gone!
And in her shoe there's a chocolate letter.
A big A made of chocolate, for Anaya!
And another little parcel.
Anaya opens it.
It's a book full of stories!
Thank you, Saint Nicholas!
shouts Anaya.
And on the 6th of December, the big Saint Nicholas day, she gets another present.
But that's a secret!
